name: Cosmic Cowboy completion kit
description: Add a silver hat, tinsel fringe, satin trousers, and a blue bandana to boots you already own.

owned.note: Use your own pointed western boots in black, white, or silver. Boots are required and are not included in the purchase subtotal.

extraSupplies: Your own plain base top to wear beneath the open jacket

steps: Put on your base top, silver trousers, and owned boots.
Add the tinsel jacket and check that the fringe clears your hands.
Fold the blue bandana into a triangle and tie it loosely at the neck.
Fit the cowboy hat. Leave the lights off or follow the supplied battery and button instructions.
Walk and sit in the full outfit. Adjust the trouser hem so it clears the floor.

notes: The catalog purchase subtotal is $79.97 USD before shipping, tax, and any extra supplies. Four merchants may charge separately.
Assembly time is an estimate after the pieces arrive. It has not been measured.
The jacket is L/XL only. The trousers use S/M/L/XL sizing. Check both merchants' measurements before ordering.
The jacket uses allover tinsel fringe rather than a tailored western yoke. The trousers have satin sheen rather than foil shine.
Delivery for the complete kit is unconfirmed. Processing times are not arrival dates; check every merchant against your event date.
The cheaper Johnnie Brocks trousers are not used because the checked page still displays an online-ordering pause.

evidence.note: The merchant page lists one hat at $9.99, installed replaceable batteries, an adjustable chin strap, and activation instructions.
In-stock orders received by noon Pacific ship the same business day. Transit depends on destination and service; no arrival date is established.
The merchant identifies a KBW adult L/XL silver tinsel fringe jacket at $24.99.
Items typically ship within 24 hours of cleared payment. Weekend orders may wait until the next business day; no transit estimate is published here.
The page lists silver satin wide-leg trousers at $39, with S/M/L/XL options, front pleats, and a button/zip fly.
The page states processing and shipping within 1–2 business days. It lists $12.95 domestic shipping below $99, without establishing an arrival date.
The merchant lists the royal blue paisley bandana at $5.99 and specifies 100% cotton and 22-by-22-inch dimensions.
Retail orders usually ship within 1–2 business days. Basic USA delivery is estimated at 5–7 business days; Canada is 10–21. These are estimates.

rationale: Buying the visible silver pieces preserves the theme without assuming a special jacket or metallic trousers are already owned. Reusing boots avoids a size-sensitive footwear purchase.

name: Velvet Vampire completion kit
description: Build the cape, ruffles, black waistcoat, and silver ornament around your own black trousers and boots.

owned.note: Use your own black tall boots. They are required and are not included in the purchase subtotal.

steps: Put on the ruffled shirt, your black trousers, and your black tall boots.
Button the waistcoat and adjust its back buckle without flattening the shirt ruffles.
Drape the cape over your shoulders and arrange the red lining so it shows at the opening.
Place the magnetic brooch on the shirt or waistcoat. Keep the cape's own closure responsible for holding the cape.
Walk, sit, and raise your arms. Check the cape hem and adjust it before leaving.

notes: The catalog purchase subtotal is $98.39 USD before shipping, tax, and any extra supplies. Four merchants may charge separately.
Assembly time is an estimate after the pieces arrive. It has not been measured.
The shirt has one standard size, up to a 42-inch chest. Confirm the fit; this kit does not cover every body size.
The cape is adult size. The waistcoat has separate S–5XL options; use its size chart.
The brooch is silver-tone and magnetic. It is not a sterling silver gemstone brooch or a load-bearing cape fastener.
Delivery for the complete kit is unconfirmed. The cape and waistcoat still need merchant-specific delivery checks against your event date.

evidence.note: The merchant page identifies Underwraps #30355, an adult black velvet hooded cape with red satin lining, at $21.99.
The merchant lists FM-64755 at $22 and describes a white poly-cotton shirt with front ruffles, lace sleeve trim, and a 42-inch chest limit.
In-stock orders ship the same or next business day. The FAQ estimates 1–7 business days to reach domestic customers, depending on location and method; international delivery can take longer.
The page lists the black brocade waistcoat at $32.45, with S–5XL options, a V-neck, three front buttons, and an adjustable back buckle.
The page lists a $21.95 magnetic sunburst brooch, approximately 2.5 inches across. The merchant warns that its magnet may interfere with pacemakers.
For USA orders, the merchant quotes arrival within eight business days for standard service or five for expedited service, excluding weekends and holidays. Confirm service for your address.

rationale: The red-lined cape, white ruffles, black brocade, and silver ornament carry the vampire look. Reusing black trousers and tall boots keeps the catalog purchase subtotal below $100.

name: Linen Ghost completion kit
description: Shape one white linen sheet over light clothes and brown boots you already own.

owned.note: Use your own comfortable white, cream, or pale natural T-shirt as the hidden base top.
Use your own comfortable light-coloured trousers as the hidden base layer. They do not need to be linen.
Use your own brown lace-up boots. The hem should reveal the boots and stay clear of the floor.
Use your own closed safety pins inside the sheet to secure it to the cap. This replaces the optional decorative shawl pin.

extraSupplies: Your own fitted baseball cap, worn backward beneath the sheet

steps: Put on the light base layers, boots, and a backward baseball cap.
Ask a helper to drape the sheet evenly. Mark the cap position, eye openings, and a hem that clears your shoes.
Remove the sheet before cutting. Cut generous eye openings and trim the marked hem.
Secure the sheet to the cap with closed safety pins inside the fabric. Keep pin points covered and away from skin.
Put on the costume and check your view in all directions. Enlarge the openings if the sheet blocks your view.
Walk, turn, sit, and raise your arms with a helper nearby. Adjust the drape so it stays clear of your feet.
tools: Washable fabric marker or tailor's chalk

notes: The catalog purchase subtotal is $64.99 USD before shipping, tax, and any extra supplies. This assumes you own the listed clothing, cap, pins, and tools.
Assembly time is an estimate. The draping and cutting have not been timed or tested with this linen sheet.
The selected sheet is white Queen, 90 by 102 inches. It is white rather than the off-white natural linen in the original look.
This is a DIY drape, not a finished costume. Cutting permanently changes the sheet; fit it before making openings.
Delivery is unconfirmed. The merchant publishes processing time, but no address-specific arrival date was checked.

evidence.note: The page lists a $64.99 flat sheet in 100% stonewashed linen and shows White / Queen, 90 by 102 inches, among its options.
The warehouse needs 1–2 business days to process an order and operates Monday through Friday. Actual delivery can change with external conditions; processing is not arrival.
Howcast's published sheet-ghost tutorial uses a cap, pins, marked eye openings, and a trimmed hem. This supports the method, not a measured build time for this sheet.

rationale: The draped linen creates the visible costume. Reusing hidden light layers, brown boots, and pins avoids purchases that add little to the silhouette.
